decision.reason: [ev-37215a11e33d] says only that controller-assigned IPs now respect per-proxy DNS capture the same way ephemeral auto-allocated IPs do. It doesn't name the setting that turns on controller-based IP assignment or the per-proxy setting that controls DNS capture. It also doesn't say what the old behavior was. Without that, no one can write an applicability condition for exposed environments. The excerpt is lines 33–34 of 52612.yaml, so the rest of that note, or the linked PR, would be needed to identify the configuration that exposes an environment.
